## What Is a Vertiv Internship?


Vertiv’s internship program places students on real engineering, analytics, and product management projects at the $10.2 billion data center infrastructure company (NYSE: VRT, S&P 500 component). The program runs as individual intern requisitions across functions rather than a single branded cohort, giving each intern direct ownership of deliverables. Vertiv holds a 3.6/5 rating on Indeed with intern reviewers highlighting real projects over busy work. For students interested in power electronics, thermal management, or the infrastructure behind AI compute, it is one of the most directly relevant industrial placements available.

## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


Requirements vary by track, but common qualifications appear across all Vertiv intern postings.


• **Enrollment:** Currently enrolled in an accredited college or university pursuing a relevant Bachelor’s or Master’s degree


• **Year:** Rising juniors and seniors preferred for engineering; MBA-level for select PM roles; graduate students for HR


• **Majors (engineering):** Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related STEM field


• **Majors (analytics/PM):** Business, Marketing, Data Science, Supply Chain, or related field


• **Technical skills:** Python and SQL required for Operations/Analytics roles; CAD for mechanical engineering


• **Work authorization:** Not explicitly stated in available postings — verify with the specific job description


### Does Vertiv Have a GPA Cutoff for Interns?


No company-wide minimum GPA was found in any available Vertiv intern job description. This does not guarantee there is no internal screening threshold, but unlike peers such as Texas Instruments (3.0 hard floor), Vertiv’s postings focus on technical skills, relevant coursework, and project experience rather than a published GPA number. A strong academic record still helps, but there is no stated cutoff screening you out.

## What Is the Vertiv Application and Interview Process Like?


Vertiv uses Oracle HCM Cloud for all applications. The process is straightforward but varies slightly by team.


1. **Visit the careers portal** at egup.fa.us2.oraclecloud.com and search "intern" or filter by function and location.


2. **Create an Oracle HCM profile** and submit your application with a tailored resume highlighting relevant technical skills.


3. **Recruiter phone screen** — typically behavioral questions assessing fit and motivation for the specific role.


4. **Technical or team interview** — project-based questions and role-specific technical assessment with the hiring manager.


5. **Offer** — delivered on a rolling basis. Apply early because roles fill and close independently.


All legitimate Vertiv applications must go through the official career website. Communications come from @vertiv.com email addresses only.[Learn more on Vertiv’s careers page](https://www.vertiv.com/en-us/about/careers/) .

## How Do You Stand Out at Vertiv?


First, demonstrate data center infrastructure literacy. Vertiv is not a general tech company — study their Liebert UPS systems, thermal management products, and Vertiv 360AI suite, then reference specific products in your cover letter. Second, build a project connecting to their growth story: a thermal simulation, power distribution efficiency analysis, or AI-driven predictive maintenance prototype shows domain passion. Third, lead with business impact in your application. Indeed reviewers note Vertiv interns work on real deliverables, so frame your experience as "reduced X by Y%" or "built Z that served W users" to signal you are ready for meaningful project ownership.

## FAQ


### What types of internships does Vertiv offer?


Vertiv offers engineering internships (electrical, mechanical, thermal, test), analytics and operations internships requiring Python and SQL, product management roles including MBA-level positions, project coordination, and sales tracks. With 15+ roles typically posted simultaneously, the company spans technical and business functions across its critical infrastructure business.


### When should I apply for a Summer 2027 Vertiv internship?


Apply now. Vertiv posts intern roles on a rolling basis year-round, and as of August 2026, 15+ positions are already live. Roles fill individually without a published deadline, so earlier applications have a material advantage. Monitor the Oracle HCM portal weekly for new openings.


### How much do Vertiv interns get paid?


Community data reports an average of $23.36 per hour based on six Indeed data points, with a range of roughly $12 to $36 per hour depending on role and location. Engineering roles likely cluster in the $23 to $36 range. Vertiv does not publish official intern salary bands.


### Where are Vertiv internships located?


Most roles are in the Columbus, Ohio metro area (Westerville and Delaware) near global headquarters. Additional positions appear in Greenville, South Carolina and at various US manufacturing facilities. Some engineering roles list flexible US locations across Vertiv’s 30 production sites.


### Does Vertiv sponsor visas for interns?


Not confirmed either way from available postings. Analogous industrial companies using Oracle HCM typically require US work authorization without sponsorship for intern positions. International students should verify the specific job posting and confirm whether CPT authorization is accepted.


### What is the Vertiv intern interview process?


Expect a recruiter phone screen focused on fit and motivation, followed by a technical or behavioral interview with the hiring team. Difficulty is moderate. No standardized online assessment or HackerRank challenge was documented for Vertiv interns.


### What background do I need for a Vertiv engineering internship?


Electrical or mechanical engineering majors are preferred for technical roles. Key skills include power electronics, thermal systems, CAD tools, and lab testing methodology. For analytics and operations roles, Python and SQL proficiency are required. No company-wide minimum GPA was found.


### Do Vertiv interns receive full-time offers?


No official conversion rate is published. Structural signals are positive: the company frames early-career hiring as a pipeline, reviewers mention growth potential, and rapid business expansion ($10.2B revenue from AI infrastructure demand) suggests expanding headcount needs.
